prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-view game sprite animation sheet. Create original fan-made pixel-art sprites faithfully depicting D-Walker from Metal Gear Solid V The Phantom Pain, based on the official E3 2015 sortie-preparation render: compact man-height open-topped gray olive biped platform, angular box torso cockpit, small sensor mast with cyan optical lens, two slim reverse-jointed mechanical legs with visible large circular knee/hip joints, flat angular feet and heel wheels, skeletal manipulator, exposed pistons, short side-mounted Gatling barrel. No humanoid head, no human rider, not a giant Metal Gear, no roof canopy. Preserve recognizable actual D-Walker silhouette and realistic machine proportions adapted into crisp detailed 2D pixel art. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 separate complete full-body poses on solid flat #FF00FF magenta. Thin pure cyan grid lines at the 5 boundaries of each axis, equal square cells. Every cell generous 12% empty margins; no touching cell lines. All machines face RIGHT, side orthographic profile, stable scale and common ground line, no perspective floor. Row1 idle: four distinct subtle sensor scanning and chassis settling phases. Row2 move: four truly different alternating-leg walking phases. Row3 attack: gatling aiming then firing then recoil then returning, small yellow muzzle flash confined inside cell. Row4 react: hit recoil, crouch brace, recovering, standing ready. No text labels, UI, watermark, gradients in background or drop shadows. Exactly 16 drawings; do not duplicate a single pose. Draw the mechanical limb articulation independently in each pose.
review: Original fan-made pixel adaptation. Reviewed compact biped, sensor, knees, Gatling and profile against official E3 render; not a certified 1:1 reproduction.
